pr_title: DECODER & ENCODER: use property definitions instead of getting implementation parameters
pr_body:
The OSSL_DECODER and OSSL_ENCODER libraries used to ask each decoder implementation for certain data in form of parameters to place them correctly in the decoder chain, if at all.  These parameters were duplicates of properties of those same implementations, and therefore unnecessarily redundant.

Since we're adding functionality to query property definition values, those duplicates are no longer needed, and are therefore not looked at any more.

Fixes #15500

issue_context.title: Encoders and decoders implementations should be possible to filter using their properties
issue_context.body:
The current way to select among the multitude of encoder and decoder implementations is done by getting a set of implementation level params (OSSL_PARAM entries).

However, these are duplicates of properties assigned to these implementations, for technical reasons (we currently don't have a way to query property definition values).  It would be much better (and most of all, kinder to those implementing decoders) if this duplication wasn't necessary...  it's also likely that querying property values is faster than getting params.

Related to #14217
